title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: When parents can reach you
hook: A parent texts you at 10:30 at night.
intro: It is about tomorrow's batting order.
q1: Do you set hours when you answer messages —
q3: What happens to you when every message is urgent?
t1: Both can work. But volunteering lasts longer
t2: when your time has some limits.
cta: Coaches — do you set message hours?
ctaLines: Before 8 pm. Weekends off. Whenever I can.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent texts you at 10:30 at night.
It is about tomorrow's batting order. You are already in bed.
Volunteers need limits, too.
Set message hours or answer whenever. Both can work.
Do you set message hours? Share your habit in the comments.
